statement: Fix the finite set of weights needed in Section 4. By taking L sufficiently large, all the following contraction constants can be made smaller than any prescribed κ > 0: ∥Tjm∥ ≤ κ∥m∥ (xrj (m) = 0), ∥T (2) j K∥ ≤ κ∥K∥ (grj (K) = 0), and ∥T (k) j A∥ ≤ κ∥A∥ for homogeneous connected arrays of orders k = 3, 4. Norms here and below have the fixed input and output weights allocated to the corresponding estimate. The bounds are uniform in j. The two projections above intertwine transport with multipliers L and 1.
